title: Nashville Party Barge: Ultimate Party Tour & Bar Stops
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Cruise through Nashville's vibrant streets on the Ultimate Party People Tour, where music, drinks, and unforgettable fun await. Dance and mingle as you visit some of the hottest bars, all while enjoying a BYOB experience tailored to your party’s vibe. Perfect for birthdays, bachelorette parties, or any celebration, this 1.5 to 2-hour tour ensures every participant has a great time with plenty of photo opportunities and lively music. Let your designated driver handle the logistics while you soak up the Music City atmosphere. 

- Enjoy a fun-filled 1.5 to 2-hour tour through Nashville's nightlife
- BYOB policy allows you to bring your favorite drinks onboard
- Ideal for celebrations including birthdays and bachelorette parties
- Cooler, cups, ice, and an aux cord are provided for your convenience
